_readme: Third-party assets vendored into this repo verbatim, and the pins that
track them upstream. scripts/check_vendor.py is the tool: it verifies
every file still hashes to its pin (offline, no Nix), reports when
upstream has moved (--upstream), and performs the bump (--update NAME).
Each file is byte-identical to the artifact at `url`, so `sha256` is
upstream's own hash and anyone can re-derive it. Never edit a vendored
file in place -- a local patch makes the pin unverifiable. Patch upstream,
or carry the change in our own code next to the include.
Why vendored and not fetched: deployed boxes fetch modules/agent-box.nix
as ONE file (issue #51) and the settings daemon serves pages that load no
external asset, so a CDN reference is not available to us even in
principle. See AGENTS.md, 'Vendoring a third-party asset'.

packages.name: idiomorph
packages.note: DOM morphing for the settings/workspace live swap. Replaces a wholesale replaceWith(), whose collateral damage -- lost focus, lost caret, a folded row snapping shut under the operator (issue #410) -- was being hand-repaired after every swap.
